publish.description: Turn your Steam Deck into a Bluetooth speaker: phones, tablets and PCs can connect and play music straight out of the Deck's stereo speakers. A2DP sink built on PipeWire / WirePlumber — no root required. Discoverable keep-alive, in-plugin pairing, cross-suspend restore, codec tuning, equalizer, multi-output sync. UI follows your Steam language (English / 中文).
